chunks: From him, from Ibn Fazzal, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Ash'ari, from Ubayd ibn Zurara, who said:
I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'From what Allah assisted with against the liars is forgetfulness.'
ai.seo_question: How does forgetfulness assist Allah against liars according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies forgetfulness (*al-nisyān*) as a divine instrument used to expose liars, a concept deeply rooted in Shia hadith sciences (*ilm al-rijal*) where the reliability of a narrator is often assessed by their memory. This principle suggests that inconsistencies arising from forgetfulness can serve as a natural safeguard against deliberate fabrication, thereby validating the authenticity of transmitted knowledge. It highlights the interplay between human cognitive limitations and divine providence in preserving the integrity of religious teachings.
